card.name: Punctuation ending a sentence or section
card.fires_on: Mostly punctuation marks such as a period, closing bracket, semicolon, comma or opening parenthesis, often at a sentence or section break. Also fires on a few joining words and spaces inside numbers and doses.

modes.label: Sentence or section end
modes.description: A period or closing bracket that ends a sentence or heading, just before a new section begins.
modes.example: have to be addressed<<. >>BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE DRAWINGS

modes.label: Punctuation inside lists and references
modes.description: Commas, parentheses, semicolons or closing brackets in citations, number lists and chemical names.

modes.label: Dose and number joints
modes.description: A space or the word to between numbers and units in dose ranges.
modes.example: 5 mL of saline solution containing from 5 mg<< to>> 10 mg of phentol
